sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast, a podcast to practice your English listening for advanced Learners.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast，這是一個為高級學習者練習英語聽力的podcast。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about dreams don't be confused.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談夢想，不要迷惘。

sentences.en: I don't mean dream as in your life goals and aspirations when I say dreams.
sentences.tc: 當我說夢想時，我指的不是你的人生目標和願望中的夢想。

sentences.en: I'm referring to the dreams.
sentences.tc: 我指的是夢想。

sentences.en: They are so mysterious I dream almost every night.

sentences.en: I love it.

sentences.en: I want to remember it.

sentences.en: I wake up feeling inspired to try new things to study new things.
